title: Synth Receipt
description: Receipt produced after Synth writes a candidate.json.

source_pattern.description: Pattern name from instinct-observations.md that triggered this hypothesis.

candidate_id.description: Kebab-case ID of the produced candidate.json.

candidate_path.description: Full path to the written candidate.json.

decomposition_required.description: true if original pattern required splitting before a candidate could be written.

questions_surfaced.description: Open questions surfaced to human before candidate was written.
